subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this ownership-aware Claw status/remove contract after the prerequisite package lifecycle lands?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but destructive cleanup and durable ownership/adoption semantics are permanent product contracts that an open RFC and tests cannot approve automatically.

options.title: Sponsor after RFC acceptance
options.body: Approve the lifecycle contract, review and land the prerequisite stack in order, then merge this slice with its security-boundary proof intact.

options.title: Land status only
options.body: Retain read-only lifecycle visibility while deferring removal and package-uninstall semantics until the ownership contract is accepted.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the draft stack open while maintainers revise or replace the ownership and recovery model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Approve the lifecycle contract, review and land the prerequisite stack in order, then merge this slice with its security-boundary proof intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible product-model reviewer and supplied the removal-ownership requirement implemented here.
